runMatrix.rule: Each cell reports separately. Cross-profile or cross-host speed comparison is allowed only between runs with equal quality outcomes and recorded network/machine context.

statistics.qualified: at least 20 samples plus 1 excluded warm-up; nearest-rank p95
statistics.agent: at least 3 repetitions per task, host and profile; report pass rate and median
statistics.failures: failed samples stay in the sample set; success-only statistics are reported separately

qualityMetrics: compile-first-time rate and validate cycles per change
server readback equivalence and final byte audit
error classification parity (CLI/MCP) and actionable next step present
secret leaks in transcripts, arguments and outputs (must be 0)
speedMetrics: sqlclTimings: sessions, connected sessions, reused flag, spawn/connect/execute ms
deployment phase durations from the journal
job observation count and wait overhead
agent scenario wall time, turns and tool calls
host token delta (normalized counters, see host usage adapters)

startupContextBudget.note: Set after the first HCX-002/HCL-002 measurement; until then report the value without a pass/fail verdict.

limits: Budgets and baselines are diagnostic, not an SLA. Baselines bind to their recorded machine, SQLcl, target and network; private evidence paths are local and Git-ignored.
